liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lazy River Road** (1 review): Reviewer praises the great harmonies on Lazy River Road [15]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Ramble On Rose awesome [9]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Reviewer calls this their favorite Vince-era Scarlet>Fire, played smoothly with a transition jam free of filler [9]
- **Fire on the Mountain** (1 review): Reviewer praises the jam after the final Fire lyrics as fantastic, and Corinna>Jam as nice [10]
- **I Need a Miracle** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Miracle>Attics sequence fantastic, while Samba and Corinna are unimpressive [9]

## The recordings

- **gd94-10-14.sbd.perkins.9054.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 166 min; rated 4.04/5 by 45 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard recording quality is great; Reviewer says the soundboards from both the 13th and 14th sound great; Reviewer says levels are nice and Vince and all band members are clearly audible [10][11][15]
- **gd1994-10-14.sbd.gardner.5204.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 165 min [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has intermittent digital static during Scarlet, between roughly five and seven minutes in [2]
- **gd1994-10-14.fob.schoeps.unknown.taylorc.83822.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 172 min [3]
- **gd1994-10-14.nak300.bleich.LMPP.96383.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 170 min; rated 3/5 by 5 [7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls a fan with a hairspray bottle and lighter spraying flame during the intense Fire [12]
- Reviewer also remembers the hairspray flame during Fire, and says New Yorkers went wild at Ramble On Rose's New York City line [13]
- Reviewer says the Garden exploded during Scarlet>Fire and recalls hallways during Looks Like Rain while the crowd wound down slowly [18]
- Weir played acoustic guitar for part of the show; a tape flip after Ramble On Rose is crossfaded [7]
- Reviewer says apart from Jerry's slow fingers, voice, and Samba, it ranks among the top five post-Bruce shows [10]
- Reviewer attended the six-night run and thought the first night, the 13th, was the best performance, despite the 35-minute Scarlet>Fire [11]
- Reviewer thinks the Seattle 6/13/94 Scarlet>Fire beats this MSG version, though this is a top-five post-Brent one [14]
- Reviewer prefers the 10-01-1994 Scarlet-Fire, saying the band is tighter with more sustained energy there [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-10-14.sbd.perkins.9054.sbeok.shnf**: source: Sbd>C>Dat>CDR>EAC>CDR>EAC>Shn [1]
- **gd1994-10-14.sbd.gardner.5204.shnf**: transferred by Tony Gardner; source: sbd>dat>c>dat>cdr [2]
- **gd1994-10-14.fob.schoeps.unknown.taylorc.83822.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Taylor C; source: (FOB) Schoeps CMC521> Sonosax SX-M2> Apogee AD-?> Sony D10* (@48kHz) [3]. Also: Received on DAT around 1997, labeled as a Schoeps CMC521 front-of-board recording; source remains unconfirmed [3]
- **gd1994-10-14.nak300.bleich.LMPP.96383.flac16**: taped by John Bleich; transferred by Brian Green and SIRMick; source: Nak 300 shotguns > WMD-6 > mac [7]. Also: Nakamichi 300 source patched with the Schoeps front-of-board recording, shnid 83822, during I Need A Miracle [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead Madison Square Garden](https://wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com/2021/05/grateful-dead-madison-square-garden.html) [21]
